newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gateway EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gateway EPS view cut.

text.p: SoundView Financial Group Inc said it trimmed its fiscal 1997 earnings estimates on Gateway 2000 Inc to $3.80 a share from $4.12 a share.
-- said cut the June 1997 quarter to $0.71 a share from $0.91 a share.
-- said cut the fiscal 1998 estimate to $4.71 a share from $4.73 a share.
-- said ratings are unchanged as a short-term and long-term buy.
-- Gateway fell 2-7/8 to 31-7/8 on the NYSE.
-- After the market closed on Tuesday, Gateway said it expects its revenues for the second quarter to be about even with the first quarter's level of $1.42 billion.
